name: Pugnuts Ice Cream Shop
closed_reason: Closing permanently on Sunday, Oct. 11, 2026, after a decade (opened 2016), as owners Eric Treworgy and Karl Holmes retire.

name: MacLeod's Restaurant
closed_reason: Closed April 1, 2025 after 45 years (opened 1980) and the building was sold; it reopened in October 2025 as Stowaway's Town Tavern and Ugly's Bar, which itself moved to Blue Hill in 2026.

name: Cherrystones
closed_reason: Seafood restaurant closed after 13 seasons (opened 2012); the building was sold in January 2026 and the space leased to a new tenant opening a different restaurant.

name: Quoddy Bay Lobster (Quoddy Bay Seafood)
closed_reason: Replaced at the site by Look Lobster (Look Lobster Quoddy Bay / Look Lobster Rolls and Market), which is in the guide.

name: Pilgrim's Inn
closed_reason: Sold in spring 2025 to Andrew Shapiro and Bosco Hernandez and renamed The Ark ('formerly Pilgrim's Inn'), an inn with a seasonal dining program.

name: Lubec Brewing Company
closed_reason: Brewery and tap room shut down Aug. 18, 2026 after 11 years; owners cited health issues.
